mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.food_id, c.quantity, f.name AS food_name, f.price, f.image_url, f.stock, f.status FROM cart c JOIN food f ON f.id = c.food_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.food_id, c.quantity, f.name AS food_name, f.price, f.image_url, f.stock, f.status FROM cart c JOIN food f ON f.id = c.food_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.food_id = #{foodId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, food_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{foodId}, #{quantity})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND food_id = #{foodId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND food_id = #{foodId}
